name: ossay-guard
description: Checks the real license of a package before the agent installs it (npm, pnpm, yarn, pip, uv, poetry, cargo, go get) and asks you first when it is non-commercial, source-available, unlicensed or otherwise restricted.

mode.title: When a package's license is restricted
mode.description: warn: ask you before the install runs (default). block: deny the install and tell Claude why.
